June 7, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Bouchey Financial Group Ltd increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 13.01% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bouchey Financial Group Ltd bought 2,949 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 25,624 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.30 million, up from 22,675 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bouchey Financial Group Ltd who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $949.46 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.42% or $0.81 during the last trading session, reaching $193.17. About 3.91M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 7, 2017 and is uptrending.
